analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.proofBody: A click means a button was pressed and the visitor left for another app. We can't see what happened next — a review click isn't a review. Only saved contacts and leads complete inside TapTap, so only they count as confirmed.
analytics.opensNote: Views and QR scans. NFC taps also record a view, so they aren't counted twice.
analytics.dailySummary: {{total}} page opens over {{days}} days. Busiest day {{day}}, with {{count}}.
analytics.arrivedBody: What actually opened the profile: a card, a QR code or a link.
analytics.notRecorded: From before TapTap recorded how visitors arrived. Left unattributed rather than guessed.
analytics.cardsBody: Taps from each of your cards.
analytics.noCardTaps: No card taps in this period.
analytics.actionsBody: Counts clicks, not whether the action was completed.
analytics.whereBody: Approximate, from the network. Never precise, and nothing personal is stored.
analytics.hoursNote: Hour of day, East Africa Time
analytics.hoursSummaryNone: No activity by hour in this period.
analytics.basicNote: How visitors arrived, which card, where and when show on accounts with an active TapTap card.
analytics.noActivityBody: Share your link or tap a card, and the numbers appear here. A longer period may show more.
analytics.emptyBody: Once you have a profile on the TapTap website, its taps, scans and clicks appear here.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: This deletes your TapTap account. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.goes: Your profiles, their actions and analytics, and every lead. Your cards stop working: anyone who taps one sees nothing.
deleteAccount.stays: Payment and order records, with your name, phone number and delivery details removed, for 5 years, as Kenyan tax law requires.
deleteAccount.shared: Only you are removed. The business, its profiles, cards and leads stay for everyone else.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Everything listed above happens now. You'll be signed out.
deleteAccount.doneMember: You've been removed from the business account.
deleteAccount.staff: Hornbill staff accounts are removed by an administrator.
deleteAccount.reauthenticate: Please confirm it's you again, then try once more.
deleteAccount.failed: Couldn't delete your account. Nothing was lost; try again.
deleteAccount.offline: Connect to the internet to delete your account.

push.title: Notifications
push.explainerTitle: Know the moment a customer gets in touch
push.explainerBody: Get a notification when someone leaves their details, when a new card is first tapped, and before a card's term ends. Customer names never show on your lock screen.
push.refused: Notifications stay off. You can turn them on in Account at any time.
push.blocked: Notifications are off for TapTap in your phone's settings.
push.thisPhone: These switches are for this phone. Other phones signed in to your account keep their own.
push.cannotRegister: This phone can't receive notifications yet. Try again later.
push.offline: Connect to the internet to change notifications.
push.privacy: Notifications never include a customer's name or number. Open the app to see who it is.

kinds.leadHint: When someone leaves their details on one of your profiles
kinds.first_tapHint: When a card you've received is tapped for the first time
kinds.termHint: Before a card's term ends, and if it stops

push.helpBody: Tecno, Infinix and itel phones close apps in the background to save battery, which can stop notifications. Allow TapTap to keep running:
push.helpStep2: Under Battery, choose No restrictions (or Allow background activity).
push.helpStep3: Turn on Auto-launch (or Auto-start), if your phone has it.
